description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.tldr: Gain significant expertise in studying, tracking, and hunting a specific type of enemy.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.tldr: Gain specialized navigation, foraging, and survival benefits in a chosen type of terrain.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.tldr: Adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty (Archery, Defense, Dueling, Two-Weapon Fighting).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You can cast nature-themed ranger spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Ranger Archetype
features.tldr: Choose an archetype that defines your wilderness training and specialized tactics.

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.tldr: Focus your mind to sense whether certain types of creatures are present nearby.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Favored Enemy (2nd choice)
features.tldr: Choose a second type of favored enemy and gain its linguistic and tracking benefits.

features.name: Natural Explorer (2nd terrain)
features.tldr: Choose a second type of terrain type in which you excel as a natural explorer.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.tldr: Move through nonmagical difficult terrain without extra cost and avoid plant-based hazards.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.tldr: Spend a minute camouflaging yourself against a solid surface to gain a massive bonus to stealth checks.

features.name: Natural Explorer (3rd terrain)
features.tldr: Choose a third type of terrain type in which you excel as a natural explorer.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Vanish
features.tldr: You can use the Hide action as a bonus action, and magical tracking cannot track you easily.

features.name: Favored Enemy (3rd choice)
features.tldr: Choose a third type of favored enemy and gain its benefits.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Feral Senses
features.tldr: Preternatural senses help you fight unseen enemies without disadvantage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.tldr: Become an ultimate hunter, adding your Wisdom modifier to attack or damage rolls against your favored enemies.
